scientific_integrity: An analytically proven finite-tree extremal theorem. The original exact variance formula for arbitrary tree passage times is credited to Aldous–Fill; the asserted contribution is a constrained sharp extremal classification with equality cases, not a new general moment identity.
scientific_limitations: Only discrete-time non-lazy nearest-neighbor simple random walk and an adjacent bridge in a finite tree; no stochastic-order comparison. The older full thesis and parts of the 2026 preprint could not be inspected; priority is provisional.
title: Sharp degree-conditioned variance corridor for tree edge-passage times
